capabilities: Organize scenes into ordered, nestable scene lists with multiple drafts
Group subplots, characters, and custom note sets into configurable folders
Compile a project into a manuscript via workflow-based steps
View scenes on a timeline or status-driven kanban board
Edit an subplot-and-character grid across the scene hierarchy
extras: Fork was explicitly approved by the original Longform author; warning that upstream Longform and this plugin must not be enabled simultaneously; dual-licensed with a restrictive license for the fork's additions; user-script compile steps were removed for security; documentation lives in separate repository files (GETTING_STARTED.md, TIMELINE.md, etc.).
intentEvidence: It is a fork of Longform: everything Longform does — scenes, drafts, word counts, writing sessions, and compile workflows — is still here
motivation: To extend Longform with configurable note groups and lightweight auxiliary views without changing its project layout, so existing Longform projects keep working.
problem: Writers organizing novels, essays, and screenplays need project-level structure like subplots, character notes, status boards, and timelines that stock Obsidian folders don't provide.
summary: Fork of the Longform writing plugin that adds configurable note groups, a timeline, a kanban board, and an editable subplot grid for long projects.
